description: Screen-addressable navigation, review deep links, and the amendments write path in the prototype playground shell.
notes: Covers the playground app itself, not generated prototypes. Companion coverage for prototype content lives in future feature areas. Run against `cd prototype-playground && npm run dev` with the savings example visible (Show examples checked).

test_cases.description: A reviewer jumps from the scenario sub-menu straight to any declared screen without walking the flow.
pre_conditions: The dev server is running and the catalogue shows the savings automation example
The Focused control variant and the Happy path scenario are selected

steps.action: Open the prototype and wait for the preview to show the pot overview screen.
steps.expected_result: The sub-menu lists the Happy path screens in order, each with its § reference and a chevron.

steps.action: Click the Review your automation screen row.
steps.expected_result: The preview shows the review screen immediately, the row is marked current, the stage title reads Review your automation, and the PRD strip shows the §5.1 chip.

steps.action: Click the numbered screen row 1 again.
steps.expected_result: The preview returns to the overview screen and the address bar ends with screen=overview.

test_cases.description: A copied review link restores the exact variant, scenario, screen, and fixture state.
pre_conditions: The savings automation example is open
The Validation error scenario declares a screen whose fixture holds amount 750 and the bounded error copy

steps.action: Select the Validation error scenario and jump to its amount screen from the sub-menu.
steps.expected_result: The preview hydrates with the amount field showing 750 and the message Enter an amount between £1 and £500 already visible.

steps.action: Copy the address bar URL, open a new browser tab, and paste the URL.
steps.expected_result: The new tab shows the same variant, scenario, and screen with the same fixture state, without any manual clicks.

steps.action: Press the browser back button in the original tab.
steps.expected_result: The previous screen selection is restored from history, including the sub-menu highlight.

test_cases.description: An amendment proposed in the shell is saved to the prototype directory, changes status, and survives a reload.
pre_conditions: The dev server is running with write access to the repository
The savings automation example is open and declares at least one screen

steps.action: Open Propose amendment, fill title, note, author, and pick the current screen and a requirement, then save.
steps.expected_result: A new amendment card appears with status Open and the open count increases; no error is shown.
The amendment is still listed with the same title, screen, requirement, author, and date.

steps.action: Choose Resolve on the new amendment, then reload again.
steps.expected_result: The card shows Resolved, the open count decreases by one, and the status persists after reload.

steps.action: Open amendments.json in the prototype directory.
steps.expected_result: The file contains the amendment exactly as shown in the shell, as valid JSON.

test_cases.description: Switching variants keeps the reviewer on the equivalent screen when the target variant declares it.
pre_conditions: The savings automation example is open on the Focused control variant
Both variants declare a screen with the id review

steps.action: Jump to the review screen from the sub-menu.
steps.expected_result: The address bar ends with screen=review and the review screen is visible.

steps.action: Switch to the Guided trust variant.
steps.expected_result: The guided review screen is visible immediately and the address bar keeps screen=review.
The focused review screen is visible; no step of the flow had to be walked.

test_cases.description: The static hand-off bundle shows amendments and notes read-only without the write path.
pre_conditions: A hand-off bundle has been generated with npm run handoff for a prototype that has amendments
The bundle's index.html is opened directly from disk

steps.action: Inspect the notes column of the hand-off bundle.
steps.expected_result: Design notes and amendments are listed, and Copy amendments JSON is offered instead of Propose amendment.

steps.action: Jump between screens from the sub-menu.
steps.expected_result: Screen navigation works offline; no network request is made and no save action is offered.
